input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: There is no post-termination transition or data-return provision anywhere in this hosting agreement. Section 13 only puts the burden on Client ("Client is responsible for arranging for a new name server within 30 days" / "a new hosting environment within 60 days"), Section 14 addresses only the wind-down of services following Client's termination notice, and Section 10 (Confidentiality) imposes no return or destruction obligation on TrueLink. That fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus data export within 30 days), so we insert a short exit clause at the preferred level: six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Client data return/deletion clause after Section 14.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement has no exit provisions, so we added transition assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates plus return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days and written certification of deletion thereafter; we can fall back to 90 days of assistance if six months is an issue.

ops.text: TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all Client Content and other Client data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
